summary.text: Battlebond's story follows the twin sisters Naiva and Baishya on a high plateau, where their grandmother Yasova Dragonclaw leads a hunting party that must hide from dragons such as Atarka's broodlings.
A vision from Ugin sends them toward his grave, and it shows the twin dragons Nicol and Ugin hatching among their hunted siblings.
A messenger named Tae Jin later recites Ugin's words about how Nicol took the name Nicol Bolas and left his brother behind in search of a better way to avenge their sister.
